exposure: Total protein intake in the first two weeks
Energy intake in the first month of life
cohort: A cohort of 135 preterm infants with a birth weight less than 1250g, compared between those who developed bronchopulmonary dysplasia (BPD) and those who did not.
finding: Preterm infants with bronchopulmonary dysplasia (BPD) exhibited suboptimal bone growth, including worse metacarpus bone transmission time and lower phosphatemia, and a higher incidence of Metabolic Bone Disease compared to preterm infants without BPD.
